thumbnails.scene: The Geek holds out a brand-new round plush cream cat bed with a flat deadpan face, while the silver tabby cat sits happily inside the plain brown cardboard box the bed came in, ignoring the bed.

A brand-new round plush cream cat bed sits empty on a rug while the silver tabby cat sits squeezed into a plain brown cardboard box right beside it, and the Geek stands between them with his arms out in a flat baffled deadpan pose.

The silver tabby cat sits crammed into a small white shoe box far too small for it, its sides spilling over the edges, looking smug, while the Geek crouches beside it staring with a flat deadpan look.

The silver tabby cat sits perfectly in the middle of a square outline of blue painter's tape on a wooden floor, while the Geek kneels beside it holding the roll of tape with a flat disbelieving deadpan look.
Only the silver tabby cat's eyes and ears peek out over the rim of a plain brown cardboard box, watching the Geek's ankle as he walks past with a mug and a flat deadpan face.
